They move their paws in a dabbing motion while standing in a line, surrounded by parked motorbikes and rows of narrow buildings under power lines. (2) The camera cuts to different groups of bipedal cats, including black-and-white tuxedos and calicos, all wearing similar black uniforms. They execute high kicks and energetic arm pumps in perfect synchronization. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of their fur and the surrounding asphalt road and urban clutter. (3) The scene alternates between various cat trios, each performing distinct choreographed moves like side-steps and fist pumps. One group wears uniforms with silver belts. The background remains a consistent Japanese residential alley with bicycles, utility poles, and clear skies, maintaining a high-energy, playful atmosphere throughout the sequence.
